verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL and not PASS. Long window (BTCUSDT SPOT 2017-08..2024-06, PRE_REG_LONG.md frozen first) triples the sample but prereg_gate (m = 48) still BLOCKs every timeframe (15m closest: 282 days vs 424 needed). 0 of 48 confirmatory cells survived the DEV rule

why: Malkan bear gate never fires: 0 bear weeks in 360 (monthly RSI14 never <= 40 since 2017-08; closest 40.4 in 2023-01); the definition was NOT changed; primary bearish cells have 0 events.

15m aligned long: n 482 / 282 days net -0.080 % [-0.216, +0.055], excess over bull drift +0.027 % (t 0.40); run 1 was n 164 net -0.176 %. Ungated 15m long net -0.102 % [-0.160, -0.045] (n 2091): a gate-vs-ungated gap is not established.
Bear proxy P40 aligned shorts 15m n 434 net -0.158 % [-0.278, -0.039] (shorts lose after cost; Holm 0.38); 1d n 2 net +16.3 % is a two-trade artifact (n < 30).
0 survivors (dev_survivors_long.json is []). Next step is more symbols, not another BTC DEV read.
